tool.description: Convert a spreadsheet (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xls, or .ods) to CSV. Provide the file via `url` (a public http/https link) or `ref` (an uploaded attachment id). Optionally pick a sheet by name or 0-based index; defaults to the first sheet.

url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the spreadsheet to convert.

ref.description: Attachment id of an uploaded spreadsheet (alternative to url).

sheet.description: Worksheet to convert: a sheet name, or a 0-based index as a string (e.g. "0"). Defaults to the first sheet.
